notes_for_editor: Thin on primary keeper data: roster is LighthouseFriends only (no USLHS for Canada); keeper table columns in the Marine reports not matched. Tower height conflicts (LF 38 ft 9 in to lantern deck; record 20 m). First-lit: 1907 temporary vs 1908 vs 1909 permanent light. LF says lens retired 1997, CCG says automated since 2003. Omitted, as single-source and sensitive, the LF account of the first keeper's sister's death in 1908. Federal heritage page 4276 and Parks Canada pages did not render, so 20 m is not cited. Several details (Valencia, Frost, Soquel, WWII) rest on LF alone. Fact-check: Marine report 1909 volume trail passage confirmed as 1907 season (began June 1907, work suspended 30 Nov). Roster expanded to every name in LighthouseFriends list; LF is the only roster source. Footnote 8 page 102 from corpus.py page.
